# AbstractAssistant

> A macOS-first tray assistant and CLI that is a thin client of AbstractGateway: the gateway owns workflows, durable runs, tools, workspace policy and multimodal defaults; the app owns the interface, local preferences and voice capture/playback. Use these docs to install it, connect it to a gateway, configure it, and understand what runs where.

Repository: https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractassistant

## Core Docs
- [README.md](README.md): overview, capabilities, quick start, local files
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index
- [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md): pip install, the `voice` extra, the optional macOS app bundle
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): start a gateway, launch the palette, first turn, approvals, shortcuts
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components, gateway boundary, sessions on the gateway, automations (diagram, polling, capability gate), run lifecycle with live replies, console sign-in hand-over, module map
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): CLI entry points and flags (`--gateway-handover-file`, `run --stream`), which gateway the app connects to (incl. the `~/.abstractframework/gateway.json` pointer file), environment variables, run input pins, live reply events, gateway routes used (sessions and automations included), local files
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): recurring questions and known limits
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes and fixes

## Topic Deep Dives
- [docs/settings.md](docs/settings.md): every setting (the Workflow page with Open in AbstractFlow and the account Time zone, Stream replies, MTP depth, the account and chat workspaces, tool categories sorted and collapsed, the global shortcut's Accessibility state and Configure, appearance, About), its source (gateway default vs. this app) and its storage in preferences.json
- [docs/voice.md](docs/voice.md): spoken replies, dictation, the hands-free conversation loop and its failure handling
- [docs/automations.md](docs/automations.md): configurable growing-context budgets and result email; scheduled tasks on the gateway as the Assistant shows them: the Sessions | Automations tabs, New automation and Schedule this conversation (Gateway default first; When = Repeat / Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Once at / email, the gateway's schedule-preview sentence and the account time-zone line; stop after / stop at), served schedule and next run, tool consent, runs as chat pairs, controls, answering waits by kind, Discuss, notifications and polling, the capability gate, limits

- [phone/iphone/README.md](phone/iphone/README.md): native iPhone assistant, scoped tools and automations, generated images and voice attached to restored messages; [phone/iphone/CHANGELOG.md](phone/iphone/CHANGELOG.md) records native release history; [phone/iphone/docs/architecture.md](phone/iphone/docs/architecture.md) covers authenticated artifact previews and session restoration; [phone/iphone/BUILD.md](phone/iphone/BUILD.md) covers isolated builds; [phone/iphone/docs/distribution.md](phone/iphone/docs/distribution.md) explains credential-free CI, human-approved uploads and TestFlight-to-Store promotion

## Design Records
- [docs/adr/README.md](docs/adr/README.md): architecture decision records
- [docs/adr/0001_gateway_native_assistant_v2.md](docs/adr/0001_gateway_native_assistant_v2.md): the gateway-native boundary

- [watch/apple/README.md](watch/apple/README.md): AbstractAssistant for Apple Watch (0.3.0, pre-release through TestFlight), a watch-only watchOS 26+ client of the same gateway: voice Ask around the orb with the work shown live (steps under the orb, pulses), tools and workflow per conversation, images and recordings in answers, approvals (Accept all taken back with the shield), sessions with search and archive, automations; [watch/apple/docs/README.md](watch/apple/docs/README.md) indexes its pages; [watch/apple/docs/architecture.md](watch/apple/docs/architecture.md) maps each screen to its gateway call; [watch/apple/BUILD.md](watch/apple/BUILD.md) builds and tests it; [watch/apple/CHANGELOG.md](watch/apple/CHANGELOG.md) is its release history
